page.overview:
Who is Boris Ursa?

Boris Ursa was the legendary first tzar of the Kislevites, and is known by the current people of Kislev as the "Forever Tzar." Boris led the Gospodars through the Dark Lands, defeating the Orcs and Hobgoblins who gathered armies to destroy his peoples.

The legends of Kislev tell that one day the Forever Tzar shall rise from his sleep and lead the Kislevites to a final crushing victory against Chaos. The legends tell that Boris Ursa rode to battle on the back of a mighty black bear granted to him by the gods themselves. In 1500 IC, he led the Kislevite hordes over the Worlds Edge Mountains and declared the northern lands of the Old World as the Kingdom of the Kislevites. He founded the fortress-monastery of the Sons of Ursa.

In 1512 IC, Boris Ursa left the newly-fledged kingdom in the hands of his daughter Miska the Slaughterer.

Many years latter the Forever Tzar appeared in a dream to Tzar Alexandr Njevski, directing him to build Castle Alexandronov.
